; Fast monochrome refresh only for the diary on the verified 3.20 firmware.
AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
    IMPORT xofm.libs.epaper 1.0 RemarkablEpaper
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Rectangle#mainWindowView > FBController
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            RemarkablEpaper.ScreenModeItem {
                anchors.fill: parent
                visible: !root.minimized && windowCanvas.active && root.appName === "Живой дневник"
                objectName: "remarkabl-fast-ink"
                mode: RemarkablEpaper.ScreenModeItem.Mono
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
